data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2019 the syndicate held gross claims outstanding of GBP 480.188m. During 2019 there was a small net favourable movement on prior years with a gross release of GBP 4.042m, driven by favourable claims development/IBNR recalibration across prior years. The managing agent also reports profit releases on open years of GBP 7.3m during the year, while separately noting strengthening in long-tail international casualty reserves affecting the calendar year result.
raw_causal_phrases: The performance in the year has been impacted by strengthening to long tail international casualty reserves.
Profit releases on open years of GBP 7.3m (2018: GBP 9.2m) were made during the year.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Insurance liabilities) prior-year comparative. Prior year development (gross) taken from movements in insurance liabilities note (Movement arising from prior years). No LOB-level prior year movement amounts disclosed; casualty strengthening referenced qualitatively in management commentary but not quantified. No claims development triangle provided in the extracted pages.
